tools.name: search_stash
tools.description: Search the user's saved social-media posts by keyword or by meaning (describe it loosely: 'that hotel room under the sea'). Use at the START of any work task (coding, design, agents, automations, writing, client or session planning, research), before proposing an approach. Returns compact hits; call

tools.name: get_stash_note
tools.description: Read one saved post in full (summary, next step, transcript, permalink).

tools.name: list_stash_topics
tools.description: Topics present in the user's saves, with counts.

tools.name: list_stash_mentions
tools.description: Books, movies, shows, podcasts, places, or people named across every saved post, not just one. Use for 'what books/movies have I saved', regardless of what those posts were mainly about.

tools.name: save_link
tools.description: Save a reel or post link to the user's Skwirl (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or X). Skwirl turns it into a note in a few minutes. Use when the user shares a link and wants to keep it.

tools.name: mark_stash_used
tools.description: Mark a save as acted on. Call it when you actually used a note. It is the only signal that separates a knowledge base from a graveyard.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stash, get_stash_note, list_stash_mentions · Public sink: get_stash_note, list_stash_mentions, save_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stash, get_stash_note, list_stash_mentions · Public sink: get_stash_note, list_stash_mentions, save_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
